narr: Thunderstorms developed across northwestern Arkansas during the late evening of the 17th and early morning of the 18th, as a low level jet strengthened across the area, forcing warm, moist and unstable air over a stationary frontal boundary that stretched through the region. Slow-moving thunderstorms that moved repeatedly over the same areas resulted in locally heavy rainfall and some flash flooding.
